\begin{example} \end{example}[Symmetries of the submersion tensors] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0227 1. ch13:13.8\group Riemannian Submersions

For vertical $U,V$ and horizontal $X,Y$, \[ A_XY=-A_YX,\quad \langle A_XU,Y\rangle =-\langle A_XY,U\rangle , \quad T_UV=T_VU,\quad \langle T_UX,V\rangle =-\langle T_UV,X\rangle . \] \end{example}
Proof

\sketch Metric compatibility gives the inner-product identities. Integrability of the vertical distribution and torsion-freeness give $T_UV=T_VU$. The Koszul formula gives $A_XY=\tfrac 12\mathcal V[X,Y]$, hence skew-symmetry.

□
